title: fix(pm): the record writer refuses a Head-sha key followed by a hex span anywhere on a line; a backtick fence's info string holds no backtick
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMzsEnY5eHjuNZKQgC1AUAt)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwv77cYicgaKyj39Y2

Fixes #28111

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：PR #28103 契约复核留下的 should-fix 1–3。(1) `post-stamped.mjs` 发帖前的 `Head-sha` 拒收加第二条「有键」判据：行内任何位置「键名紧跟 7–40 位十六进制码段」也算作者写了键。#28103 把判据收窄到「以键开头的行」后，16 种读取器读不出 head 的写法（键前有单词、一行两个键、表格行、下划线强调、任务列表项、题头样式、unicode 项目符号或 emoji、项目符号后接引用、删除线、括号、NBSP 缩进、HTML 注释）悄悄通过了；现在又都拒收。(2) `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']`、拒收文案和函数注释改说题头「缩进最多三个空格」，不再说「不缩进」，与读取器一致。(3) `check-half-states.mjs` 的 `FENCE_LINE`：反引号围栏的信息串含反引号时不开栏（CommonMark §4.5），波浪线围栏不受此限。共 2 个文件，+45/−13。
- 为什么改：三项都是 #28103 复核记录 6523547564 点名的。第 1 项是响亮度：作者写了一条读取器读成「无 head」的记录，却听不到一句拒收。卡片给了 (a) 加判据 / (b) 记录边界两个选项，要求先测再选：实测第二判据在 2026-10-23 以来 11764 条评论（750 条带题头记录）上一条都不多拒，所以选 (a)。第 2、3 项是措辞与 CommonMark 规则，均属 cosmetic。无新门禁、无新拒收类。
- 风险与回滚：语料前后对比（基线 `27e0bd584` vs 本 head）：750 条记录读法逐条相同（0 变），11764 条评论拒收逐条相同（0 变）；#28103 放开的散文提及（只提键名、或码段在句子后面）仍不拒；新判据唯一会拒的散文形态是「键名紧跟码段」出现在读不出 head 的记录体里，这是卡片接受的边界，线上 0 例，已钉住。围栏规则只会让读取器读到更多本来就该读到的行（0 条线上记录含该形态）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`post-stamped.mjs` 的 `HEAD_SHA_KEY_SPAN` 与 `headShaKeyPresent`（两行），再看 `check-half-states.mjs` 的 `FENCE_LINE`（一行）。
- 两分钟验证：五个自测在本 head 全部 exit 0：half-states 5131（主干 5130，+1 钉）、recognisers 337、post-stamped 753（主干 747，+6 钉）、owed-reviews 65、guard 403。三条消融各恰红本项新钉：去掉第二判据 4 枚红、围栏规则还原 1 枚红、措辞还原 1 枚红。
- 需要你做的：无。本 PR 不碰四个契约面，不欠契约复审；落地档以登记册为准（本地 `--test` 读为两条路径均不在登记册上，普通队列落地）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` — item 1, choice (a).** A second presence limb, `HEAD_SHA_KEY_SPAN` (`/head-sha[`*_~]*[ \t]*:[ \t*_~|]*`[0-9a-f]{7,40}`/i`): the key directly followed by a 7-to-40 hex code span, anywhere on a line, through the decoration a key or a value may wear. `headShaKeyPresent` is the OR of the two limbs and replaces the bare `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE.test` in `recordKeyedLineRefusals` and in the `headShaKeyLine` locator. The refusal's `why` names both limbs. The docblock records the 16 shapes the limb restores, the prose shapes that stay free, the one prose shape it refuses (the key immediately followed by a hex span inside a sentence) and the corpus measurement behind accepting it.
- **`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` — item 2.** `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` says the heading is `itself indented at most three spaces`; the refusal `why` and the `recordKeyedLineRefusals` docblock say the same; `unindented` is gone from all three.
- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — item 3.** `FENCE_LINE` is `/^[ ]{0,3}(`{3,}(?!.*`)|~{3,})/`: a backtick run opens a fence only when the rest of the line carries no backtick; a tilde run's info string may hold one. `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE`, the walker and every other reader are untouched; the docblock cites CommonMark §4.5 and the #28103 review's F16.
- **Pins.** post-stamped: the 16 shapes in two pins (each refused AND reader null), the freed prose cases (no span, span later in the sentence, a sub-floor span, a non-hex span) stay free, the accepted prose bound (refused in a reader-null body, passes beside a plain key line), the locator quotes the span-limb line and the `why` names both limbs, the spelling and the `why` grant the heading three spaces and never say `unindented`; the existing wording pin is loosened to `BELOW an unquoted`. check-half-states (H51 block): a backtick run with a backtick in its info string opens nothing (the line below reads; after a later bare run the FIRST plain line still wins), a backtick-free info string opens, a tilde run with a backtick in its info string opens, and such a line inside an open four-backtick fence stays fenced.

## Why

The contract review of PR #28103 (record 6523547564) left should-fixes 1 to 3, filed as #28111 and triaged p3 (6524831843: loudness only, no wrong head admitted). Measured on `origin/main` `27e0bd584` before the change (`skills-lane-seat2/28111/probe-shapes.mjs` in the project files, both trees):

1. All 16 shapes the review listed (plus a second table-row spelling) pass `recordKeyedLineRefusals` untouched and read `null` in `contractReviewHeadSha`: a record that silently reads as no record.
2. The spelling said `unindented` of the heading while the reader opens the scope on `/^[ ]{0,3}#/`.
3. ```` ``` a`b ```` opened a fence, so the record's own `Head-sha:` line below it was skipped (fail-closed; CommonMark renders the line as a paragraph).

**Item 1, (a) versus (b), measured before choosing.** The card prefers restoring loudness where it costs no live false positive. The span limb's false-positive population is a line that matches `HEAD_SHA_KEY_SPAN` but is not a key line. On the 11764 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23 (REST, 118 pages, fetched 2026-10-30T14:40Z; 750 carry the heading marker): **0** such lines in any comment, **0** in any record, so **0** records newly refused; 0 records carry the key anywhere without a key line. Choice (a) therefore costs no live refusal, and the one synthetic prose false positive the review named (P3, the key immediately followed by a hex span inside a sentence) is pinned as the accepted bound so the next reader of the function knows it was chosen. Choice (b) was not taken.

No new gate, no new refusal class: the writer's refusal fires on a superset of what it fired on after #28103 and a subset of what it fired on before (every shape it now refuses, base-before-#28103 refused too), and the reader's accept set only grows by lines CommonMark already rendered as paragraphs.

## Verification

- Self-tests on the committed head `30a0fbad`, exit captured before any pipe: `check-half-states --self-test` 0 (5131 cases; main 5130), `record-recognisers --self-test` 0 (337), `post-stamped --self-test` 0 (753 across 26 batteries; main 747), `check-owed-reviews --self-test` 0 (65 in 9 batteries), `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` 0 (403).
- Ablation on the committed head (`skills-lane-seat2/28111/ablation.log`), each leg one `sed`, restored with `git checkout`, porcelain empty: (A) `headShaKeyPresent` back to the line limb alone: post-stamped 4 of 753 red, all four the new span-limb pins; (B) `FENCE_LINE` back to the base shape: half-states 1 of 5131 red (the new info-string pin), post-stamped 0; (C) the spelling back to `unindented`: post-stamped 1 of 753 red (the new wording pin). No other pin moves in any leg.
- Corpus (`skills-lane-seat2/28111/probe-corpus.mjs`, `probe-corpus.out`): 11764 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23, 750 carrying the heading marker, driven through `contractReviewHeadSha` and `recordKeyedLineRefusals` in a worktree at `origin/main` `27e0bd584` and one at this head: 0 records read differently (the 2 nulls are the two no-key legacy records on both trees), 0 comments refused differently (the 1 refusal on each side is the pre-existing `Local-runs` row on record 6517315440); 0 lines match the span limb without being a key line; 0 comments carry a backtick fence opener with a backtick in its info string.
- Shapes (`probe-shapes.out`): on this head each of the 17 shapes is refused and reads null; P1 (no span) and P2 (span later in the sentence) stay free; P3 (key then span in a sentence) is refused as the accepted bound; P4 (a plain line above a prose mention) reads and passes.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the two files: exit 0.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` at the committed head `30a0fbad` derives 48 families (26 pnpm, 22 direct node); all 48 run in a second worktree at this head after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, every exit 0 (`skills-lane-seat2/28111/gates-ran.clean.txt`); `--ran` reconciles 48 derived / 48 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN. No changeset derived: no published package is touched, `skip-changeset` rides the create.
- Landing tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the two paths answers 0 of 2 on the register (not governed, ordinary queue landing); the register's reading at PR time is the seat's. No contract review is owed: none of the four contract faces is touched.
